import {dbOf} from './module-db.ts';
const sql = dbOf('publication');
/** @param {string} q */
function f(q) { return sql`true`; }
({f}={f:sql.unsafe});
export function shorthand() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${f('EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)')}`; }
/** @param {string} q */
function g(q) { return sql`true`; }
for ({g} of [{g:sql.unsafe}]) {}
export function forOf() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${g('EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)')}`; }
/** @param {string} q */
function h(q) { return sql`true`; }
({value:h}={value:sql.unsafe});
export function explicit() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${h('EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)')}`; }
